practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Identify Project (System), Identify basic requirements and users.
Based on the information Write Introduction, Abstract, Scope and
prepare Use Case Description Document

practicals.title: Practical-2
content: Use Case Diagram: Design a UML Use Case Diagram to represent
the functional requirements of the selected system. Identify actors,
use cases, and relationships such as include, extend, and
generalization

practicals.title: Practical-3
content: Activity Diagram: Develop an Activity Diagram to model the
workflow of the overall system. Represent decision points, parallel
activities, and process flow logically.

practicals.title: Practical-4
content: Flowchart: Create a system-level and module-level flowchart
showing procedural logic. Use standard flowchart symbols to
represent process, input/output, and control flow

practicals.title: Practical-5
content: Sequence Diagram: Design a Sequence Diagram to illustrate
interaction between objects over time. Show lifelines, activation
bars, and message passing for a core transaction.

practicals.title: Practical-6
content: Context-Level DFD (Level 0): Prepare a Context Diagram
representing the system as a single process. Identify external entities
and major data flows entering and leaving the system.

practicals.title: Practical-7
content: DFD Level 1: Develop a Level 1 Data Flow Diagram by
decomposing the main system process. Ensure proper balancing of
data flows with the Context Diagram.

practicals.title: Practical-8
content: DFD Level 2: Create a Level 2 DFD for one major subsystem of the
project. Provide detailed decomposition while maintaining logical
data consistency.

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Entity Relationship (ER) Diagram: Design an ER Diagram to model
database entities, attributes, and relationships. Specify primary keys,
foreign keys, and cardinality constraints.

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Class Diagram: Develop a UML Class Diagram representing system
structure in object-oriented form. Define classes, attributes,
methods, and relationships such as inheritance and aggregation.

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Mini Software Requirement Specification (Mini SRS): Prepare a
concise SRS document following IEEE standards for the selected
project. Integrate all diagrams and clearly define functional and
non-functional requirements.
Total Hours 28
